Quality-controlled shipborne Conductivity, Temperature, Depth (CTD) profile observations collected during cruise CE22009 aboard the R/V Celtic Explorer from 2022-05-18 to 2022-06-02. The dataset includes cast identifiers, station names, location, time, depth, pressure, dual-channel temperature, conductivity, salinity, potential temperature, sigma-theta, sound velocity, dissolved oxygen, turbidity, fluorescence, transmissometer/voltage channels, and corrected chlorophyll.
